ideas.title: Investigation into Feeding Our Future fraud case
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud case, including the guilty plea by the owner of Star Distribution and the involvement of other entities.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the entities involved
questions: What were the specifics of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a significant amount of money and multiple entities. Investigating the specifics of the fraud and the entities involved could uncover a larger pattern of corruption.

ideas.title: GOP criticism over Minnesota Somali Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the GOP criticism over the handling of the Minnesota Somali Fraud case, including the response from Governor Walz and AG Ellison.
ideas.angle: Investigate the handling of the case and the response from officials
questions: How did Governor Walz and AG Ellison respond?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves the handling of a significant case and the response from officials. Investigating the specifics of the criticism and the response could uncover a larger pattern of corruption or mismanagement.
